newsitem.title: USA: Los Angeles council OKs $273 mln City Hall repairs.
newsitem.headline: Los Angeles council OKs $273 mln City Hall repairs.

text.p: The Los Angeles City Council has given final approval to the $273 million seismic retrofit and repair of City Hall, officials said on Thursday.
The council voted 11-to-2 to approve the plan.
The City Hall rehabilitation project is estimated to total $273 million. The vast majority of the costs will be funded from voter approved bonds and a federal disaster grant.
A small general fund contribution estimated at $4 million is required for relocation expenses not otherwise eligible from existing bonds or grants, project planners said.
Since 1987, the city has been preparing for the seismic rehabilitation of the City Hall building.
Although the estimated cost of the project has soared, city officials said the project was necessary.
